status: experimental rule sets (not final; see TETRA_VARIANTS_REPORT.md)

rulesets.name: Tetra rules (recommended)
rulesets.desc: Closer to Tetra Master: no bonus for a pointing-back arrow, and combos stop after one level (the card you place attacks, each card it captures attacks once, and cards captured after that only flip). The first player gets a 2-point bonus at the end.

rulesets.name: No combos
rulesets.desc: The simplest version: only the card you place attacks. Captured cards never attack. No pointing-back bonus. First-player bonus of 2.

rulesets.name: Classic chains + fair start
rulesets.desc: The original v0.2 rules (unlimited chain reactions, +1 Guard for a pointing-back arrow) with the first-player bonus of 2.

rulesets.name: Classic v0.2
rulesets.desc: Exactly the handoff rules. Unlimited chains. The second player has a measured advantage.
